source.citation: Transcribed verbatim from a live concurrency experiment log, raw bytes of the listener-conflict 409
source.notes: Transcribed from a human-readable experiment transcript rather than a raw meta.json/xml capture pair — hence source.type is 'live-capture-transcribed'. The source dates the experiment window as 2026-08-02, 18:26-19:51 UTC with no per-request clock timestamp for this exchange, so recordedAt above is the window's start, not a precise per-exchange timestamp; the wire timing that IS given is the response duration (106ms), preserved as recordedDurationMs. Response body transcribed exactly and independently byte-counted at build time: 633 bytes, matching the recorded content-length: 633. A second trial returned the identical 633 bytes in 76ms and reproduced an earlier capture of the same phenomenon exactly (same status, length, AdiFailed/conflictDetected/SY/530/conflictText). x-csrf-token and Cookie values were already <redacted> in the source; the placeholder is preserved as-is, not re-fabricated.
